name: manual_956fc5
claim: Inspect a Python tool's entry point before assuming it supports --help; a script without argument parsing can treat that flag as a filesystem path.

decisions.notes: The memory renderer created a scratch --help directory when invoked with --help, requiring explicit cleanup of only the artifacts created by that mistake.

rationale: The memory renderer created a scratch --help directory when invoked with --help, requiring explicit cleanup of only the artifacts created by that mistake.
